doshas.Pitru Dosha: Pitru Dosha is a planetary flaw that means a karmic debt of the ancestors, which is to be paid by the person afflicted with Pitru Dosha in the Kundli. It is formed when your forefathers have committed any mistakes, crimes, or sins in their life journey. In return, you have to pay the karmic debt by experiencing different challenges or punishments in your life.
